Ramkhamhaeng Hospital Group
One of the largest private hospital groups in Thailand
•Founded in 1988 by a group of doctors with >35 years of 
hospital operating experience

## Page 21

Key Development : RAM Hospital
Endoscopic Ultrasound (EUS) —a technology that enhances the accuracy 
of disease detection and diagnosis through ultrasound imaging performed 
via an endoscope.
EUS can be performed on both the upper GI tract —such as the esophagus, 
stomach, and duodenum —and the lower GI tract, including the colon and 
rectum. It can also be used to examine internal organs located near the 
digestive tract, such as the gallbladder, liver, and pancreas.
☑️Clearly visualizes abnormal masses outside the GI tract
☑️Enables precise tissue sampling, reducing steps and improving 
diagnostic accuracy
☑️Helps physicians plan treatments more accurately and safely
EUS enhances diagnostic precision for various conditions such as cancer, 
bile duct stones, and pancreatic disorders, and allows physicians to 
efficiently plan appropriate treatment.
21

## Page 22

Key Development : RAM Hospital
On October 16, 2025, Ramkhamhaeng Hospital held a press conference 
announcing its rebranding initiative to better meet the needs of the new 
generation, who are increasingly focused on holistic health. The hospital 
aims to provide comprehensive care in every dimension of life, moving 
beyond being a place that focuses solely on treating illnesses. It is also 
committed to helping build a comprehensive Healthcare Ecosystem under 
the vision “THE COMPLETE EXPERT, FOR YOUR DESIRED HEALTH”
The goal is to ensure that Thai people have access to international -standard 
medical services while supporting Thailand’s ambition to become a regional 
Medical Hub capable of attracting patients from around the world
22

## Page 23

Key Development : RAM2 Hospital
Civil servants under the Comptroller General’s Department can receive 
radiation therapy for cancer at RAM2 Hospital without advance payment.
RAM2 Radiation Therapy Center –Equipped with 4D technology and 
committed to enhancing the quality of cancer care with advanced treatment 
technologies, while increasing access to treatment for patients under various 
healthcare schemes.
▪Comprehensive treatment planning
▪Advanced -level radiation therapy techniques
▪Care provided by oncology specialists and a multidisciplinary team
▪Fast treatment initiation
▪Online consultation channels
23

## Page 24

Key Development : RAM 2 Hospital
RAM2 Hospital has expanded outpatient services. 
The Internal Medicine Department, Cardiology Department, and Ear, 
Nose, and Throat (ENT) Department will be available on the 2nd floor 
of the hospital building starting from 15 July 2025 . 
This expansion aims to increase access to care provided by specialists 
in various fields and to accommodate the growing number of 
patients.
